div.font: [Software system]

div.style: font-size:12px;text-align:left;padding:0 40px
div.font:
Web app and mobile app for BP customers.
What it does
• Shows account movements and history
• Transfers and payments between own accounts
• Transfers and payments to other banks
• Opens accounts for new customers with ID and face check
• Sends an alert for every movement (SMS and email)
• Records every action in a tamper-proof audit trail
• Stays available and recovers on its own if parts fail
